caption: The drawing depicts a single object placed vertically on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a central fabric portion that is primarily gray with black and white horizontal stripes and a thick texture, wrapped in a way that suggests it is a folded or bundled textile. Attached to each end of the fabric are identical leather components colored in shades of brown, with a rounded, almost shield-like form and a built-in handle. The leather appears stitched and secured around the end of the fabric bundle. There is a tuft or tassel in darker gray and black shades attached to the center of the fabric. The object's overall composition is symmetrical from top to bottom. In the lower right corner, there is the text "Arthur E. Reynolds" written in black ink.
title: Cinch
